data.summary: In this intensive one‑week sprint the student will review every AP Chemistry unit, focusing on concise, high‑yield practice that reinforces core concepts and exam skills. Each topic is paired with a targeted task that can be completed in a single sitting, allowing the student to maximize the 10 available hours.

weeks.focus: Comprehensive review of all units with timed practice questions
tasks: Do 5 free‑response questions on mole calculations (1.1) and check answers with the scoring guide (30 min).
Complete a set of 4 multiple‑choice questions on periodic trends (1.7) and review the answer explanations (20 min).
Work through 6 practice problems on chemical bonding types and Lewis structures (2.1, 2.5) and self‑grade (30 min).
Solve 5 FRQs on intermolecular forces and phase properties (3.1, 3.2) and compare to sample responses (30 min).
Do a timed practice on stoichiometry calculations (4.5) – 8 problems in 20 min, then verify work (15 min).
Complete 4 rate‑law FRQs covering reaction rates and rate laws (5.1, 5.2) and score them (30 min).
Run through 5 calorimetry problems (6.3, 6.4) and check solutions (25 min).
Answer 4 equilibrium FRQs on Kc and reaction direction (7.3, 7.4) and review scoring (30 min).
Practice 5 acid‑base calculations (8.2, 8.3) and compare to answer key (25 min).
Finish 4 electrochemistry FRQs on cell potentials and Gibbs free energy (9.3, 9.4) and self‑grade (30 min).

data.final_week_advice: After completing the intensive review, spend any remaining time revisiting the topics that felt most challenging, and take a full‑length practice exam under timed conditions to gauge readiness.
